package.name: rm_waypoint
package.description: ROBOT. Go-to-waypoint controller for repositioning the robot between policy runs. Publishes /teleop/cmd_vel — an INPUT to rm_safety, exactly like the gamepad — so it drives behind the same clamps, arcs and kill as every other source, and has no path to /cmd_vel. Idle until an operator sends a waypoint over /waypoint/goto, and silent (publishing nothing at all) while idle. Not part of the NCP pipeline; nothing in that pipeline reads it.
